title: Telescope assembly yields a K-projective model
statement: For universes u and v, let A : Type u be a commutative ring, P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ, F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ, ι n : F n ⟶ P, and step n : F n ⟶ F (n+1). Assume IsZero (F 0), Mono (ι n) for every n, step n ≫ ι (n+1) = ι n for every n, and exhaustive images: for every k : ℤ and x : P.X k there are n : ℕ and y : (F n).X k with (ι n).f k y = x. Assume also that for every n : ℕ and k : ℤ there is r : (F (n+1)).X k ⟶ (F n).X k with (step n).f k ≫ r = id, and that every F n is K-projective. Then there exists Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ with Q.IsKProjective and Nonempty (Q ≅ P).

proof.text: Form the explicit maps a and b on S = ∐ F. Apply the degreewise-splitting construction lemma, which has no K-projectivity assumptions or conclusion.
The checked coproduct null-homotopy argument proves S K-projective from the stages.

Use Mathlib trianglehOfDegreewiseSplit and distinguished_iff_iso_trianglehOfDegreewiseSplit. Rewrite K-projectivity as left orthogonality to acyclic complexes; this orthogonal is triangulated, so ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₃ proves P K-projective. Return Q = P and its identity isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: 2026-10-20 (Y7): reuse the proved upstream telescope assembly with the same degreewise-splitting and coproduct dependencies. Its direct P.IsKProjective conclusion implies the node conclusion with Q = P and Iso.refl P. No proof dependency is pruned.

lean.statement:
theorem filtered_free_telescope_assembly
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ)
    (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ)
    (ι : ∀ n, F n ⟶ P) (step : ∀ n, F n ⟶ F (n + 1))
    (hzero : IsZero (F 0)) (hmono : ∀ n, Mono (ι n))
    (hcompat : ∀ n, step n ≫ ι (n + 1) = ι n)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : P.X k),
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : (F n).X k), (ι n).f k y = x)
    (hsplit : ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
      ∃ r : (F (n + 1)).X k ⟶ (F n).X k,
        (step n).f k ≫ r = 𝟙 ((F n).X k))
    (hstage : ∀ n, (F n).IsKProjective) :
    P.IsKProjective
